## Purpose

Fit TWFE, ETWFE, RW, RW-IID, RW-ST and GB-Ens under the saved placebo assignments without covariate adjustment. Save county/year predictions and draws for later evaluation.

DATA
```{r}
# Load the original panel, rebuild untreated labels, configure history/spatial inputs and load placebo assignments.
dt <- readRDS("data/notpublic/compact_dt.rds") |> data.table()
dt$year |> summary()
dt$start_year |> table()

dt[, y0_25 := NULL]
dt[, y0 := NULL]
dt |> set_y0()
table(dt$year < dt$start_year, is.na(dt$y0))

load("data/W")
rownames(W) <- NULL
conf <- list(Lset = choose_lset(dt, shift_max = 3), graph = Matrix(W))
options(xpn.conf = conf)

sim_out <- readRDS("data/simulation/simulated_assignments_with_meta.rds")
sim_out$metadata
sim_a <- sim_out$assignments
dt[i %in% 1:50] |> plot_assignment_diff(sim_a[, 1, 1])
```


```{r}
# Define fit_sim(): apply each saved assignment, fit replications in parallel, and save model/scenario RDS files.
# Retain only years before observed adoption, so withheld placebo outcomes remain verifiable.
fit_sim <- function(
  fit_fun_sim
  , nboot = 200
  , nrep = 200
  , keep = c("i", "year", "start_year", "start_year_sim"
    , "urb", "y", "n", "y0_hat", paste0("y0_post_", 1:nboot)
  )
  , mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3
  , file_name = NULL
  , ...
) {
  for (k in worlds) {
    start_all <- Sys.time()
    result <- mclapply(1:nrep, \(r) {
      dt |> set_y0(A_sim = sim_a[, r, k])
      #is_test_set <- is.na(dt$y0) & dt$year < dt$start_year
      #sum(is_test_set)
      dt |> fit_fun_sim(nboot = nboot, ...)
      pre <- dt$year < dt$start_year # we only ave pre-treatment
      dt[pre, ..keep]
    }, mc.cores = mc_cores) |>
      rbindlist(idcol = "r")
    end_all <- Sys.time()
    print(end_all - start_all)
    saveRDS(result, paste0("data/simulation/wocov/new_imputation_"
      , file_name, "_", k, ".rds"
    ))
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Fit and save GB-Ens predictions for all three assignment scenarios using 200 replications and 200 draws.
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_xgb
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "xgb"
)
```

```{r}
# Limit nested numerical threads, then fit and save RW-ST predictions for all three scenarios.
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1,
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1
)
INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads = 1)
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_inla
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 16, fit_fun = fit_sptiv
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "rwst"
)
```


```{r}
# Fit and save the RW model for all three scenarios.
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_inla
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fit_fun = fit_pm
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "rw"
)
```
```{r}
# Fit and save RW-IID predictions for all three scenarios.
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_inla
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fit_fun = fit_me
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "rwi"
)
```
```{r}
# Define TWFE/ETWFE formulas, then fit and save TWFE predictions for all three scenarios.
fm_twfe <- formula(y0 ~ 1 | i + year)
fm_etwfe <- formula(y0 ~ 1 | start_year + year)

fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_fe
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fm = fm_twfe
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "twfe"
)
```

```{r}
# Fit and save ETWFE predictions using the adoption-year and calendar-year fixed-effects formula.
fit_sim(fit_fun_sim = impute_fe
  , nrep = 200, mc_cores = 18, fm = fm_etwfe
  , worlds = 1:3, nboot = 200
  , file_name = "etwfe"
)
```
